title: Check disk space usage
summary: See how much space is used and available on your Mac's drives. This helps you understand if you need to free up space.

aliases.text: how much space left on mac

steps.explain: Display disk usage in human-readable units (GB, MB) and show a grand total.
steps.expect: A table showing filesystems, sizes, used space, available space, and percentage used, with a total line.
